input.quote: then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 binds Ono and its Affiliates not to Commercialize "Competing Products" in the Ono Territory. The in-term leg is acceptable at the fallback: it is reciprocal (Array and its Controlled Affiliates are equally bound), limited to the Ono Territory, limited to Commercialization only, and limited to a defined class of Competing Products rather than any competing business. The post-termination leg fails the fallback: it runs to a redacted "[ * ] anniversary" of termination, so it is not capped at 12 months, and neither leg carries carve-outs for internal development or M&A-acquired products. Minimal cure: substitute the redacted anniversary with a twelve (12) month cap and add one concise carve-out sentence, leaving the reciprocal in-term exclusivity and the termination mechanics untouched.

ops.oldText: prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: prior to the twelve (12) month anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.

ops.text: This Section 8.2 shall not restrict Ono or its Affiliates from internal development, or from Commercializing a Competing Product acquired in a merger with, or acquisition of, a Third Party or of its business or assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We capped the post-termination tail in Section 8.2 at twelve (12) months and added carve-outs for our internal development and for products acquired through M&A; the reciprocal in-term exclusivity is untouched.
proposal.summary: Cap the post-termination restriction at 12 months and add internal-development and acquisition carve-outs.

mappings.element: Restriction limited to a named competing product.
